# Differential-run evidence, recorded (Trap D).
#
# Inputs: ../v1/patients.dat (4,812 records). Reference: the v1 COBOL run
# (../v1/report.txt, TOTALS below). Both rewrites build with rustc, no crates:
#   rustc -O wonder-bill.rs -o /tmp/wonder-bill
#   rustc -O fixed-bill.rs -o /tmp/fixed-bill
# Run each in a directory holding a copy of ../v1/patients.dat; each writes
# its own report (detail lines plus a TOTALS line in the COBOL layout).
#
# v1 COBOL TOTALS:   TOTALS RECORDS  4812 BALANCE $4814,213.63 FEE $63,904.43
# Wonder (wrong):    TOTALS RECORDS  4812 BALANCE $4814,213.63 FEE $72,213.23
#   -> 535 mismatching detail lines, listed in mismatches.txt: every one a
#      vaccination visit, charged 1.5% where the batch charges 0.00.
#      Overcharge total: $8,308.80 across 535 statements.
# Fixed rewrite:     TOTALS RECORDS  4812 BALANCE $4814,213.63 FEE $63,904.43
#   -> detail lines and TOTALS line byte-identical to the v1 COBOL run
#      (cmp clean on all 4,812 detail lines). Flags nothing: the D1 control.
#
# Blame (from ../v1/trace-summary.txt): the mismatching records are exactly
# the ones whose COBOL trace shows LOG-EXEMPT instead of CALC-LATE-FEE
# (535 LOG-EXEMPT against 4,277 CALC-LATE-FEE). Paragraphs on clean paths
# (WRITE-TOTALS, WRITE-DETAIL, TALLY-BAND) implicate no memory.
